identifications.note: Q = m004(p/q) as the G2 frame's 3-cycle, as in B1801-B1803; here with Spin(10) on it

scope.frame: Witten's discrete doublet-triplet splitting (hep-ph/0201018) in M-theory on a G2 space, with Spin(10) (a D5 singularity) on the 3-cycle instead of SU(5); breaking by flat connections; localised matter from enhanced adjoints (Acharya-Witten)
scope.object: hyperbolic Dehn fillings m004(p/q), p even, and their symmetries (B1802, B1803)
scope.hypotheses: the G2 space, the D5 singularity and the localisation are not supplied by the object; a Stueckelberg breaking of U(1)_X unchecked

claim_one_line: MATTER PARITY FROM THE TOWER ABOVE, TESTED (P-414; data-free; NEGATIVE in Witten's G2 frame, the group theory PROVED): Spin(10)'s order-2 central element z2 = exp(i pi Q_X) is exactly matter parity (-1 on the 16, +1 on the 10; not in the SM gauge group in any global form) and survives every flat breaking; but the fillings' order-2 line breaks Spin(10) to connected Pati-Salam, no flat connection gives exactly the SM (U(1)_X stays), only 1, 10, 16, 16bar, 45 localise (no 126), so the U(1)_X breaking by a 16 kills the parity; and with real Higgs 10's Witten's conditions have no solution for any exponent-2 F' (none of 31 groups; the H_u self-mass allowed in 440 of 440 cases) -- moving from SU(5) to Spin(10) trades the missing parity for a lost doublet-triplet mechanism. The first test of the owner's towers question fails in this frame. None of the 19.
